system.description: This beaten metal bears an odd triangular shape. It veritably pulses with a power that makes the hairs on the back of your neck stand up. The strange charm is tied to a course knot of what appears to be hair. The horned rat amulet increases the wearer’s soak value by 1. At the start of each session, any non-Skaven wearing the amulet must make an Average (2{Dc}) Resilience check or suffer 2 corruption (minor corruption). Each 1 rolled on this generates 1 corruption.
